title: Banner Highway 01
excerpt: Banner Highway 01: Get on the fast lane, 汽车是旅行的工具. A browser-based visual poetry series reimagining classic Burma-Shave roadside advertisement-poems for the Information Superhighway.
content_html:
Get on the fast lane, 汽车是旅行的工具 is the first installment in Banner Highway, a browser-based visual poetry series reimagining classic Burma-Shave roadside advertisement-poems for the Information Superhighway. The banners come from Banner Depot 2000, a web-based archive of 1990s–early 2000s banner ads (banner-depot-2000.net).

By Switcheristic Telecommunications : Richard Lewei Huang & Yufeng Zhao. Logo design by Kay Zeng.

Music

  • bossa.mid , An Invitation to Roland World of Music
  • poprock.mid , An Invitation to Roland World of Music
  • demo0004.mid , Monster Media No. 12
  • dreamy.mid , Microsoft Multimedia Development Kit 0.9 Beta
